# mapbox accounts

Mapbox Tokens API

The Tokens API lets you programmatically create, read, update, and delete the access tokens that authorize requests to Mapbox APIs. It also lets you validate a token and list the scopes available to an account. Mapbox uses access tokens to associate API requests with your account. There are three kinds of tokens:

3 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox accounts list-scopes

List scopes

Lists the token scopes available to an account. The requesting token must have the `scopes:list` scope. Public scopes (those usable with public `pk` tokens) include `"public": true`.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/scopes/v1/{username}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox accounts list-scopes --username USERNAME
```

### mapbox accounts list-tokens

List tokens

Lists the access tokens for an account. The requesting token must have the `tokens:read` scope. Secret token (`sk`) entries do not include the `token` string. Results are paginated; when more results are available a `Link` header with `rel="next"` is returned.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/tokens/v2/{username}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `default` | `--default` | no | boolean |  | If `true`, return only the account's default token. If `false`, exclude the default token from the results. Sent in the request query. |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | no | integer |  | The maximum number of tokens to return. Sent in the request query. |
| `sortby` | `--sortby SORTBY` | no | string | `created`, `modified` | Sort the tokens by their creation or last-modified date. Sent in the request query. |
| `start` | `--start START` | no | string |  | The token ID after which to start the listing, used for pagination. Supply the value from the `Link` header of the previous response. Sent in the request query. |
| `usage` | `--usage USAGE` | no | string | `pk`, `sk` | Filter the returned tokens by token type. Sent in the request query. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox accounts list-tokens --username USERNAME
```

### mapbox accounts retrieve-token

Retrieve a token

Checks whether a token is valid and returns metadata about it. Provide the token to check as the `access_token` query parameter. The response always uses HTTP `200` and reports the outcome in the `code` field (`TokenValid`, `TokenMalformed`, `TokenInvalid`, `TokenExpired`, or `TokenRevoked`).

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/tokens/v2`

Takes no arguments of its own.

```sh
mapbox accounts retrieve-token
```
